note: The allowed twin of step 2 and the build witness for a state reference in the reserved `_default` variant. ALPHA's VALUE names BETA as its source register; BETA delivers VALUE in its one variant, curated as `_default`; a same_as edge makes the two VALUEs one variable. BETA names no source. The old test's claim, read at the built catalog: a lineage edge keeps the source state's `_default` variant (its ResolvedStateRef leg). The edge covers both states' 2000.
fails_if: `ResolvedStateRef` (resolved_metadata.py) validates its variant as a plain slug, so the build refuses BETA's `_default` source state instead of writing the edge; or `validate_metadata_structure` reports a one-way state lineage edge as a cycle

sources.description: Alpha register (ALP) (1) delivers VALUE in 2000 labelled with Beta register (BET) as its source. Beta register (BET) (2) delivers VALUE in 2000 and names no source.
